candidates.title: Shelf Space Comparison Report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a Shelf Space Report that, for each genre and format of material, compares the percentage of total circulations, the percentage of the collection, and the percentage of total shelf space.
candidates.source_quote: The system should provide, for each genre and format of material, the ability to compare: - The percentage of total circulations - The percentage of the collection - The percentage of total shelf space
candidates.priority_signals: Included in summary by Katherine; multiple participants requested it (Thomas: "game-changing").

candidates.title: Run Report Per Library or System
candidates.statement: The system shall allow the Shelf Space Report to be run at selectable scopes: per individual library (branch) and for the entire system.
candidates.source_quote: The report should be able to run per library and per system.
candidates.priority_signals: Katherine summary; Susan and Jennifer explicitly requested per-library and per-system views; Jennifer: "Our directors review this data quarterly and need both views."

candidates.title: Breakdown By Genre and Format
candidates.statement: The system shall break down report results by genre and by format of material (show metrics for each genre and each format).
candidates.source_quote: for each genre and format of material, compare:
candidates.priority_signals: Repeated request across thread and included in Katherine's summary.

candidates.title: Compute Item Counts Per Genre/Format
candidates.statement: The system shall compute the count of items per genre and per format to derive the percentage of the collection.
candidates.source_quote: Count items per genre/format (this is the "percentage of collection")
candidates.priority_signals: Listed by Robert as required data to produce the report.

candidates.title: Compute Total Circulations Per Genre/Format
candidates.statement: The system shall compute the sum of checkouts (total circulations) per genre and per format to derive the percentage of total circulations.
candidates.source_quote: Sum checkouts per genre/format (this is the "percentage of circulations")
candidates.priority_signals: Listed by Robert; core to the requested comparison.

candidates.title: Estimate Shelf Space Per Genre/Format
candidates.statement: The system shall estimate shelf space used per genre and per format so the report can present percentage of total shelf space occupied.
candidates.source_quote: Estimate shelf space per genre/format (this is the "percentage of shelf space")
candidates.priority_signals: Robert will investigate how to estimate shelf space from existing data (action item).

candidates.title: Shelf Space Estimation From Item Dimensions
candidates.statement: The system shall estimate shelf space using item dimensions from existing item data when dimensions are available.
candidates.source_quote: We'd need to estimate based on item dimensions or use item count as a proxy.
candidates.priority_signals: Robert flagged dimensions as a preferred method; action item to investigate.

candidates.title: Allow Item Count As Shelf Space Proxy
candidates.statement: The system shall allow using item count as a proxy for shelf space estimation when item dimensions are not available.
candidates.source_quote: We'd need to estimate based on item dimensions or use item count as a proxy.
candidates.priority_signals: Robert identified this as a fallback approach.

candidates.title: Filter Report By Date Range
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to filter the Shelf Space Report by an arbitrary date range (for example, to view Q1 or Q2 results).
candidates.source_quote: Can we also filter by date range? Like, what was the shelf space utilization in Q1 vs. Q2?
candidates.priority_signals: Latoya requested date-range filtering and noted seasons matter.

candidates.title: Compare Different Date Ranges
candidates.statement: The system shall support comparing report results across different date ranges (e.g., Q1 vs Q2) to show changes over time.
candidates.source_quote: Like, what was the shelf space utilization in Q1 vs. Q2?
candidates.priority_signals: Latoya explicitly asked for Q1 vs Q2 comparisons.

candidates.title: Comparison View Side-by-Side
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a comparison view that displays each library's breakdown side-by-side to facilitate spotting outliers across libraries.
candidates.source_quote: include a "comparison" view that shows each library's breakdown side by side? That would make it easy to spot outliers.
candidates.priority_signals: Requested by Jennifer; intended for directors who review data quarterly.

candidates.title: Display Local Library With System Average
candidates.statement: The system shall display a local library's Shelf Space Report results alongside the system average so branch managers can compare local to system-level metrics.
candidates.source_quote: branch managers can see their local situation AND see how they compare to the system average.
candidates.priority_signals: Explicit reason given by Susan for per-library and per-system views.

candidates.title: Support Grouping/Aggregation Levels
candidates.statement: The system shall support configurable grouping/aggregation levels (e.g., GROUP BY genre, format, library, or system) when generating the Shelf Space Report.
candidates.source_quote: We can also add the per-library and per-system breakdown. That's just adding GROUP BY clauses to the right levels.
candidates.priority_signals: Robert noted GROUP BY as the implementation approach.

candidates.title: Export Report For Spreadsheet Use
candidates.statement: The system shall allow exporting the Shelf Space Report data in spreadsheet-friendly formats (e.g., CSV or Excel) so users do not have to pull reports manually and recreate spreadsheets.
candidates.source_quote: Currently I pull reports manually and make spreadsheets. It's tedious.
candidates.priority_signals: Thomas described current manual workflow and burden.
